packet: H4b1 aggregate sales invoice tax component
scope: One explicitly selected immutable proportional sales-tax rule version on one sales invoice issue.
Basis is the sum of currency-rounded sales_invoice_line amounts in an input-only invoice root.
One tree-less basis child and one stable tax child are source-owned siblings of the issue.
Tax child posts customer receivable, invoice outstanding, and tax-authority payable; no cash or physical stock posting is added.

mechanism.feedback_boundary: Tax output references the tree-less basis row. It does not contribute to z_taxable_input; the issue invoice reference remains plain.
mechanism.output_identity: Issue-owned stable (source, role) IDs for each aggregate basis and tax component.

rounding.zero_precision: fn::accounting::currency_round uses math::round(value) when precision is zero.
rounding.probe: At JPY precision 0, a 13.5 line amount rounds to 14 and its 10% aggregate tax rounds to 1.
rounding.engine_observation: SurrealDB 3.2.0 rejected math::fixed(value, 0) with: Incorrect arguments for function math::fixed(). The second argument must be an integer greater than 0. The helper handles zero precision without broadening this observation beyond the tested version.

checks: Inputs 3.334 and 4.444 produce line children 3.33 and 4.44 and aggregate basis 7.77; rounding the raw combined total would produce 7.78.
Independent reconstruction checks input basis, aggregate tax, customer receivable, invoice outstanding, and tax-authority payable.
Line edit, removal, and addition refresh the basis and amount while retaining stable basis/tax IDs.
Explicit version selection updates the result without changing output IDs.

Positive rates rounded to zero, fixed rules on the aggregate route, multiple aggregate components, invalid date, account, currency, precision-zero foreign currency, and key mismatches reject atomically.
A downstream customer net ceiling rejects an issue line edit and restores the source, basis, tax output, and affected roots.
Aggregate component removal, re-addition, and issue deletion prune children and restore roots.
Physical stock balance and treasury balance remain equal to their pre-tax snapshots.
probe.no_eligible_input_case: Not structurally available in the current sales issue schema: lines are required and every sales invoice line is eligible for this basis; there is no eligibility discriminator.

regression_controls.result: passed; fixed/proportional parent-local and H3a manual paths remain working

limits: Fixture-only accounting profile proof; no production migration is claimed.
One aggregate proportional component per sales invoice issue; current schema has one issue per sales invoice.
No statutory interpretation, recoverability, tax-on-tax, withholding, collection, offsets, remittance, purchase-rule migration, or multi-document grouping.
Currency precision is inherited from the invoice currency. A different currency identity is rejected; there is no independent rule precision field to mismatch against the same currency.
